theme: temple roof that drinks the rain
title: Temple Roof That Drinks the Rain: Ridgeline Drainage
strategies: trivial: reprint the unedited roof (reproduces the checker's own drainage baseline)

greedy: for the biggest puddles first, carve a straight L-shaped channel of strictly decreasing heights all the way from the puddle to the nearest gutter, giving up if an obstacle blocks the line -- pays for every cell on the path even when most of it was already draining fine

strong: treat the droplet map as a watershed partition -- for every basin, find the cheapest single boundary cell whose height can be dropped (within the max-slope bound) below its basin neighbor, and spend the edit budget on the basins with the best droplets-rescued-per-budget ratio; the surface elsewhere is left untouched because it provably cannot change the score
invalid: flood every editable cell to a huge constant height, blowing the edit budget
